venues.name: Epicenter Stockholm – The Terrace / Disruption Hall

neighborhoods.name: Norrmalm / Hötorget–Regeringsgatan (City centre)
neighborhoods.rationale: Where Cursor Meetup moved to Founders House rooftop (Luntmakargatan 22/34) because of demand; where {Tech: Europe} ran its first Swedish AI Hackathon with Founders House on Sept 13-14 2025 (60 builders); where Innovation Pioneers + Epicenter (Malmskillnadsgatan 44a) hosted a 200-person AI Hackathon on Sep 17 2025 with IKEA/Volvo/Tetra Pak intrapreneurs; the December 11 2025 ElevenLabs Worldwide Hackathon landed in this cluster too via AI Tinkerers Stockholm; plus Spotify (Regeringsgatan 19), Lovable's new 300-seat HQ (Regeringsgatan 25), Microsoft (Regeringsgatan 25) and Antler all sit inside a 5-minute walk. This is the closest Stockholm has to an AI-builder ground zero and the dominant Nordic Tech Week 2026 (Sep 7-11) side-event zone.
avoid_too: Kistamässan / Kista Science City (Data Innovation Summit, DevFest 2025, Stockholm Tech Show): real developer density but it's a suburban expo-and-office district with no café-takeover feel, hotel-conference energy, and a 20-minute pendeltåg from the centre - skip it for a coffee/hack day
Hötorgshallen food hall + surrounding Haymarket/sergelgången: tourist-trap cafés with poor wifi-outlet density, no bookable event floor, no third-space vibes

Stureplan proper (Berns, Sturecompagniet, Spy Bar corridor): bottle-service nightlife and corporate atriums, no builder culture, expensive buyouts geared toward luxury brand launches not laptop-friendly hack days
Gamla Stan: photogenic but venues are small medieval rooms, tourist-priced fika, no event-capable cafés in the 50-200 range, and not where the dev crowd actually meets

neighborhoods.name: Södermalm / Skanstull–Hammarby Kaj (Goto10–Folkungagatan axis)
neighborhoods.rationale: The recurring dev-meetup address: Foo Café runs weekly events out of Goto10 / Internetstiftelsen at Hammarby Kaj 10D (Elastic, UpCloud, DevSecOps, Civic Tech Sweden hackathons, DNS Hackathon Oct 4-5 2025), AI Sweden's own Stockholm office at Folkungagatan 44 runs its AI Lab, Impact Hack and Digital Earth Sweden hackathons, PyCon Sweden 2025 (400 attendees) was at Clarion Hotel Skanstull, and Helio Skanstull has a 100-person rooftop ('Yttre Rymden') that overlooks Södermalm. This is where the engineer-first, no-pitch Stockholm scene actually books rooms - bilingual-friendly, European-price-point, and built around fika.
avoid_too: SoFo / Nytorget café strip (Vermeers, Kaffe, Johan & Nystrom SoFo): tiny third-wave cafés, 20-40 seats max, laptops actively discouraged on weekends - good for pre-event coffee, not the venue
Fotografiska: iconic, but it's a museum with strict event pricing, no hack-friendly table maps, and closes to the public during buyouts - too expensive and too gallery-vibe
Medborgarplatsen / Götgatan nightlife strip (Hirschenkeller, Södra bar): after-work pubs, not daytime bookable event spaces

Slussen waterfront itself: still an active construction zone into 2026 with confusing pedestrian routing - the nearby A House Katarinahuset is usable but the surrounding quarter is loud and mid-rebuild

neighborhoods.name: Östermalm / Birger Jarlsgatan–Stureplan (Norrsken axis)
neighborhoods.rationale: Norrsken House Stockholm (Birger Jarlsgatan 57C) hosted the World Fixathon grand finale in Dec 2025 (200+ builders, Lovable/Spotify/NVIDIA sponsorship), runs weekly After Works and monthly Impact Meetups, and is explicitly bookable for partner events - it was the original Stockholm tech-week anchor before Nordic Tech Week even existed. A House Östermalm (the old Arkitekturskolan) hosts creative coworking and event spaces a short walk away, Sana Labs' AI Summit anchors the broader Östermalm tech conversation, and Startup Network Europe's Stockholm AI Conference ran in the Sture corridor in May 2026. Most polished, funder-and-founder-heavy cluster of the three - right if the coffee/hack day needs VC adjacency.
avoid_too: Karlaplan / Östermalmstorg interior: residential embassy-and-old-money streets with almost no event-capable cafés and very strict neighbour-noise rules - pretty, but nothing to book
Sana Labs HQ itself: members-club-style space, not publicly rentable; treat as networking target, not venue
Stureplan club corridor (V, Hell's Kitchen, Kasai): evening-only, DJ-led, no daytime hack format

A House Ark (Östermalm) - bookable but runs corporate workshop pricing, rigid catering contracts, and not hacker-floor-friendly - choose A House Slussen or Founders House instead if you want the same polish with builder energy
